create-project.title: Start by creating a project
create-project.body: Enter a trip name and press Create to start planning your journey.

search-spots.title: Search for spots
search-spots.body: Open “Spots” in the sidebar to look for places you want to visit.

chat-spot.title: Add a spot by chatting
chat-spot.body: Ask the chat something like “What do you recommend in ○○?” and the AI will suggest candidates. Save the ones you like to add them.

map-spots.title: Check them on the map
map-spots.body: Saved spots appear as pins on the “Map”. Take a look at where they are.

itinerary-dnd.title: Build your itinerary by drag & drop
itinerary-dnd.body: On “Itinerary”, drag spots and travel legs from the parts palette on the right onto each day to build your plan.
